{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ministry of Justice''' was the apparatus of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government that was in charge of the prosecution of cases and the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|enforcement of law and order]]. It was headed by a [[Minister of Justice]].

The Ministry of Justice was headquartered in a large tower on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The tallest spire of the tower had a wraparound [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] window and was used as a meeting point for the leaders of the [[New Jedi Order]].

In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]] it became the [[Galactic Alliance Department of Justice|Galactic Alliance Ministry of Justice]] when the New Republic was reorganized as the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].
